## Summary

Describe the user-visible or protocol-level outcome.

## Verification

List the focused checks you ran and their results.

## Compatibility and safety

- [ ] Ordinary Markdown remains authoritative and byte preservation is tested where relevant.
- [ ] App-only changes do not add work to the launch path without measurement.
- [ ] CLI output, errors, and exit status remain deterministic where relevant.
- [ ] Protocol or schema changes include compatibility tests and documentation.
- [ ] Generated files, private fixtures, credentials, and raw traces are excluded.
- [ ] I have signed off each commit under the Developer Certificate of Origin.

## Documentation

- [ ] User-facing behavior and release implications are documented, or this change needs no documentation.
